title: New Slots Roguelite with some AI assets released! - Dragon Era: Rogue Sots
author: Playmage
selftext:
The game used local AI model to upscale old studio assets that were pretty low res (from a mobile game released 13 years ago), then used ChatGPT and Gemini to generate several new assets for the roguelite elements and chapter backgrounds.  The coding was actually 90% manual with Antigravity helping to write few utilities.

Honestly, not expecting anything like the miracle that is Slotbound, as the game only has 300 wishlists.  I would be happy with even it hit 1% of the sales, and maybe that is still wishful thinking.  
  
Check it out if you like:  [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5074820/Dragon\_Era\_Rogue\_Slots/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5074820/Dragon_Era_Rogue_Slots/)
